name: Fashion doll
definition: a styled doll with a slim adult-like or teen body, made to be dressed and posed.
notes: Barbie Fashionistas fashion doll for styling; Hamleys Fashion Dolls category

name: Baby doll
definition: a doll made to look like an infant or toddler, for nurturing play.
notes: Bitty Baby is called a baby doll; Argos lists BABY born under Dolls

name: Ball-jointed doll
definition: a doll whose limbs and torso are joined by ball joints on elastic or string, made for posing and customising.
notes: Super Dollfie and BJD shop; dolls sold as heads and bodies in sizes

name: Bisque or porcelain doll
definition: a doll with head and body cast as one in porcelain or bisque, so that the material makes the form (E-14).
notes: bisque head dolls by Armand Marseille, Kestner and others; dealer listings

name: Articulated action figure
definition: a figure with many joints made to be posed and played with or displayed in varied poses, in any scale.
notes: S.H.Figuarts moveable figure; HLJ Action Figures category

name: Static pre-posed figure
definition: a figure fixed in one pose, in any scale including statue scale, sold finished or as an unpainted figure kit to assemble and paint (`assembly: kit`); includes prize figures and loose miniatures sold outside a game-system box (E-11, E-14).
notes: POP UP PARADE figure in one pose; HLJ Scale Figures and Figure Kits

name: Chibi or super-deformed figure
definition: a figure with an oversized head and small body, usually with swappable faces or parts.
notes: Nendoroid is non-scale articulated 100mm chibi figure with swappable face plates

name: Designer or art-toy figure
definition: a figure made as a collectible art object, often vinyl, from a designer's or brand's own character, often blind-packed.
notes: Kidrobot Dunny vinyl art figures; Pop Mart Art Figures category and blind boxes

name: Toy animal or toy soldier figure
definition: a small moulded figure of an animal or soldier made for pretend play.
notes: Schleich Horse Club toy figure; plastic and metal toy soldiers sold in 54mm

name: Bobblehead
definition: a figure with a head on a spring or pin so that it nods.
notes: bobbleheads on spring; nodder and wobbler names

name: Plush toy
definition: a stuffed fabric toy, including teddy bears, plush pendants with a clip or chain, and figures with a stuffed fabric body even with a vinyl face (K-136).
notes: Labubu vinyl plush pendant; Steiff teddy bears; Hamleys Soft Toys

name: Puppet
definition: a figure worked by the hand, rods or strings to act out play.
notes: Folkmanis hand, finger, stage and glove puppets; Hamleys Plush Figures and Puppets

name: Dolls' house
definition: a house or building made at doll scale to be furnished and played in.
notes: dolls houses and houses with furniture sold under that name

name: Figure-and-scene playset
definition: small figures sold with a scene, building or set of accessories for pretend play.
notes: Fairy Mushroom House sold with figures; Constructive Playthings playsets with figures

name: Interlocking brick set
definition: a set of plastic bricks or blocks that clip together by studs or tubes.
notes: LEGO City set in Bricks and Blocks; Brickset theme list

name: Metal construction set
definition: a set of perforated metal strips and plates joined by nuts and bolts.
notes: Meccano 5-in-1 Roadster building kit with metal parts and tools; page does not mention nuts and bolts

name: Wooden construction set
definition: a set of wooden blocks, rods or boards for building.
notes: Tegu magnetic wooden blocks; KEVA maple plank construction sets

name: Marble-run construction set
definition: a set of parts that join into a track or tower for rolling balls.
notes: Hubelino marble run building boxes with marbles and track elements

name: Toy robot
definition: a robot made as a toy for play (a kit made to teach science through experiments is C6; K-149, R-22).
notes: shop collection Robot Toys for Kids: drawing, dog, solar and programmable robots

name: Coding toy
definition: a toy made for play that teaches or plays programming by commands (K-149, R-22).
notes: Botley 2.0 Coding Robot screen-free; Sphero coding robots

name: Assembly scale model
definition: a model of a vehicle, machine or structure in plastic, resin or card, sold as a kit to assemble or pre-built; includes building, ruin, terrain and diorama kits sold for scale models or miniatures (`subject` = structure, terrain or diorama; E1-7).
notes: Tamiya plastic model kit 1/24; OO building kits sold for models and dioramas

name: Die-cast scale model
definition: a metal model of a vehicle at any scale, from 1:64 pocket cars to 1:18 display models (E-10).
notes: Hot Wheels 1:64 metal body; die-cast model cars 1:18 to 1:64 on MiniModelShop

name: Model locomotive
definition: a powered model railway engine.
notes: Hornby Locomotives category; Hattons steam, diesel and electric locos

name: Model rolling stock
definition: an unpowered model railway wagon, coach or carriage.
notes: Hearns Rolling Stock coach and freight; Hornby Coaches and Wagons

name: Model railway track
definition: rails and points for a model railway.
notes: Hornby track pieces and extension packs; Hattons Track and Points

name: Model railway train set
definition: a starter set of locomotive, stock and track sold together.
notes: Hornby Train Sets with locomotive, track and controller; Valley Drifter set; Hattons train sets

name: Model railway scenery kit
definition: buildings, scenery or lineside accessories sold for a model railway (gauge or railway scale stated; not widened, E1-7).
notes: OO building and trackside kits for model railways; Hattons buildings railways

name: Push-along or pull-back toy vehicle
definition: a plastic or wooden vehicle the child pushes or that runs by pull-back or friction.
notes: pull back and friction toy vehicles; wooden pull-along trucks

name: Wooden toy railway
definition: a wooden toy train with its wooden track system.
notes: BRIO wooden railway toys with wooden tracks; wooden train sets

name: Radio-controlled vehicle
definition: a car, boat, aircraft or hobby drone controlled by radio, sold as an RC toy or hobby model; includes combustion-engined hobby cars and camera-less toy drones (K-97, E-11).
notes: RC cars and trucks Traxxas, Axial; Tamiya Mini 4WD also on site

name: Slot-car racing set
definition: a toy car racing set with grooved track and hand controllers.
notes: Scalextric race set with track and two hand controllers

name: Ride-on car
definition: a child-sized car pushed, pedalled or powered, that the child sits in.
notes: Little Tikes Cozy Coupe ride-on toy car; Freddo electric ride-on cars

name: Balance bike
definition: a child's bike without pedals, pushed along with the feet.
notes: Strider 14X pedal-free balance bike; woom balance bikes

name: Children's tricycle
definition: a three-wheeled pedalled cycle for a young child (a children's pedal bicycle is G1, K-91).
notes: TP Toys kids trikes Zoomee
